note: LIVE figures only. Event figures and structural constants are deliberately absent , see the header of scripts/gen-index-figures.js.

figures.definition: rt is not null. 3,061 cards have no score and must never be counted as zero
figures.query: select count(*) from player_card_mv where rt is not null

figures.claim: seasons with no detailed record at all
figures.definition: all four of shots_total, passes_total, duels_total, dribbles_attempts are null. A card missing SOME of them is partial, not absent
figures.query: select count(*) from player_card_mv where shots_total is null and passes_total is null and duels_total is null and dribbles_attempts is null

figures.claim: share of the record with no detailed stats, per cent

figures.definition: shots_total is null. KEPT ON PURPOSE as the near-miss: this is the number a reader would get from the obvious query, and it is NOT the headline figure. 2026-09-13 could not tell which of the two the page meant, which is why this file exists
figures.query: select count(*) from player_card_mv where shots_total is null

figures.claim: seasons within a single point of a band edge
figures.definition: rt in [b-1, b] for each public band edge 95, 90, 85, 80
figures.query: select count(*) from player_card_mv where (rt between 94 and 95) or (rt between 89 and 90) or (rt between 84 and 85) or (rt between 79 and 80)

figures.claim: share of SCORED seasons within a point of a band edge, per cent
figures.definition: cards_on_a_band_edge / cards_scored. The denominator is SCORED, not total , an unscored card cannot sit near a band edge and counting it dilutes the figure
